title: Export a Google Sheets tab as PDF with AI
h1: make a pdf of the google sheets tab you chose
description: Export one Google Sheets tab or rectangular range as PDF. Choose orientation and gridlines, then open the file to spot tiny text and awkward page breaks.
keyword: google sheets export pdf with ai
keywords: chatgpt export google sheet to pdf
ai google sheets range to pdf
answer: **get a printable roster without exporting the budget beside it.** a bot can export one google sheets tab or rectangle as a pdf. give the original sheet link and tab name, then choose portrait, gridlines or fit to width. dusk counts export as a change, so it needs read and write access. your source cells stay untouched.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: a pdf from the tab you actually need.
what:
**get the right rows onto readable pages.** paste the normal sheet link and name the tab or rectangle. the export works on that selection rather than guessing which workbook content you want.

choose orientation, margins, sheet names and repeated frozen rows. google leaves some print settings, including margins, unclear. fit to width can still leave tiny text. open the pdf at normal size.
uses: **print the duty roster alone.** keep budget tabs out of the export.
**show only the quote that matters.** choose its approved rectangle for review.
**give a wide attendance table room.** try landscape.
**file a clean totals table.** turn gridlines off for the pdf.

routine.message: every tuesday at 15:45, open the fernwater production spreadsheet saved in the production folder. confirm the rehearsal roster tab and export its current version as a landscape pdf. fit it to width and repeat frozen rows. ask me before exporting. put the pdf here for me to read. never include other tabs, change cells or email the result.
routine.needs: google sheets connected with read and write for pdf export; access to the production folder containing the spreadsheet link
routine.output:
fernwater rehearsal roster
tab: rehearsal roster
layout: landscape, fit to width, frozen rows repeated
pdf attached. open it at normal size to read the column headings.

steps: connect google sheets with read and write. allow the pdf export action.
paste the original sheet link with the chosen tab open. published viewing links won't work.
name the tab or whole cell block and choose orientation. ask for review before export if wanted.
open the pdf. look for clipped edges and awkward page breaks before keeping the schedule.
watch: **copy the link from the right tab.** it tells the bot which one to export.
**published viewing links won't work.** use the original spreadsheet link, not a /d/e/ address.
**give the whole rectangle.** say `a1:f30` rather than asking the bot to guess the edge.
**look at the margins in the pdf.** google leaves some print settings unclear, so the file itself is your guide.

faq.q: can i export only part of a tab?
faq.a: **yes. give a rectangular range.** name the whole block, such as `a1:f30`, so the bot doesn't guess where your table ends.

faq.q: will asking every time for sends approve this export?
faq.a: **no. dusk treats export as a change.** put 'ask me before exporting' in the routine if you want that checkpoint.

steps: open the tab you want and copy its normal link
ask for that tab as a landscape pdf
choose gridlines and repeated frozen rows
open the file at normal size and read the smallest text

mistakes.fix: open the original spreadsheet and copy its link instead.
open the pdf at normal size. fitting everything can make it unreadable.

tip.text: repeat frozen rows when the reader needs column headings on every printed page.

items: only the intended tab or rectangle appears
headings and page breaks make sense
